purpose: Supplementary development and numerical regression evidence. These cases do not define supported scale or establish performance limits.

behavior.scale: Caller supplies problem size and numerical budgets; retain model, structural and backend representation requirements.
behavior.reference: auto chooses supplementary work; required attempts the requested size; skip does not build the reference. Absent checks are null/not_run or not_checked.
behavior.resources: Worker timeout and output cap default to 0 (disabled). Optional execution overrides deployment settings; numerical threads inherit caller environment or library defaults.
behavior.harnessConnection: Preset timeout is 2147483647 ms, the current Node single-timer representation ceiling. It is configurable in MCP settings.
behavior.groundStateProfile: Current profile is supplied-pauli-statevector 1.1.0; the original 1.0.0 file is retained unchanged for historical interpretation. Coarse grid and evaluation budget are caller supplied; budgetFraction is reported.
behavior.scientificAcceptance: Resource changes do not promote capability evidence levels or replace central Acceptance Builder.

independentReview.identity: unitary_science_review, separate domain reviewer with read-only product/Git access

finalReport.conclusion: No unresolved blocking finding in the reviewed primary/reference separation, numeric representation changes, resource observations or final runtime policy.
finalReport.acceptanceBoundary: Independent engineering/domain review evidence only; not central Scientific Acceptance and not a performance guarantee.

resolvedFindings.resolution: BigInt GF(2) independence; independent 17/65/129-bit cases and dependent-generator rejection.
Project unit Pauli operators before restoring coefficients; independent relative-spectrum checks and 1e-200 retained coefficient.
All-qubit tapering represented by reducedQubits=0 and empty-word scalar; signed Y and XX/ZZ sectors checked.
Python arbitrary-precision dimension transported as decimal string above JavaScript safe range; 4^27-1 verified exactly.
closureMode=skip no longer internally enumerates SDK closure; dense reference remains independent and residual target is labeled.
New Profile 1.1.0 uses evaluation budget fraction; original 1.0.0 file exactly restored; manifest digest and current selectors updated.

Requested coarse grid, refinement counts and Pauli evaluation counts no longer inherit 65/191/8192 caps. Independent 257-grid run used 301/512 evaluations; real 513-grid run used 512/512, resource pass but convergence fail.
SKILL frontmatter explicitly calls independent verification optional; equivalence failure applies only when the reference was actually computed.

structuralReview: QPanda compiler worker streams BigInt assignment masks, uses finite coefficient arithmetic and optional exhaustive replay. 13-variable required and 65-variable skip were independently executed. Python QAOA skip returns classical=null; traversal remains the selected primary algorithm, so reference not_run does not mean traversal was skipped.

Toqito dense supplied-state model retains shape, subsystem and finite-number checks; JavaScript Jacobi now rejects nonconvergence instead of accepting unfinished eigenvalues. This final pass was structural, not an additional independent full-density-matrix numerical suite.
QCEC retains unitary OpenQASM scope, safe register sizes, and upstream timeout=0. No claim that numerical simulation proves every equivalence outcome.

TJM reports deterministic zero sampling error for noise-free evolution, insufficient_trajectories/null for noisy single-trajectory sampling, and ddof=1 SEM for multiple trajectories. Time-step and tensor truncation errors remain distinct.

SQD uses installed PySCF named bases and atoms with closed-shell RHF, fixed alpha/beta particle counts, contiguous active orbitals and the same frozen-core offset for SQD and FCI. The active-space restriction norb<64 is the upstream signed-int64 CI representation boundary, not an arbitrary adapter compute budget.
Flow parity now folds all 64 bits. NumPy index/byte representation is checked before impossible allocation; this does not promise practical dense-state allocation.

FatQat fixed transmon model, QMClaw independent single-qubit synthetic models, Dynamiqs single-qubit dynamics and QGS two-qubit fixed-weight-one model remain physical/interface scope. Width/count/iteration removals do not expand them into unsupported physics.
Legacy and other paper adapters received scope/representation/reference branch review rather than a duplicate of the implementer's 18 live cases.

limits: No dependency installation, external model, cloud or hardware calls.
No product files or Git state modified by reviewer; evidence files only.
Large cases were selected for analytic or sparse/symbolic tractability; no exhaustive validation of all widths, Hamiltonians, MBQC branches, algebra classes or upstream algorithms.
Main-agent live test and Harness results were not used as independent numerical oracles.
Final legacy review is strongest for QPanda compiler, QGS resource semantics, Flow parity and shared execution; other legacy functionality remains a structural review in this pass.
